executive_summary: US equity futures and post-market sessions are surging following the dramatic reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO, triggering a historic relief rally across AI hardware, memory, and software sectors. However, macro headwinds linger as escalating Middle East tensions—notably naval mines striking oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz—keep geopolitical and energy risks elevated. Quantitative positioning favors selective accumulation in core semiconductor anchors and oversold high-conviction connectivity players while exercising caution on capital-intensive neocloud providers.

recommendations.risk: Regulatory scrutiny regarding executive governance and potential headline volatility.
